In career mode some activities are available to specific roles and levels only.  For example, the "Repair Wheel” activity is only available to engineers.
When kerbals are out and about you can direct them to interact with what's around them via the action menus.
Below are a number of activities that can be performed:

When a maneuver node is selected on the map, or by interacting with the selection display buttons (see right) the precision maneuver edit panel appears. Post-maneuver orbit information displays in the Orbit Information Panel.
Current orbit or result orbit after selected maneuver.
Switches selection to previous/next existing maneuver.
Use the handles to adjust maneuver direction by click, drag or scroll. The center buttons adjust the time of the maneuver in the same way.
Enter the UT of the maneuver in seconds or in y:ddd:hh:mm:ss format. Field automatically detects format if “:” symbol is used.
Shows the current rate of change applied when using the handles.
Increase or decrease the time of the maneuver by one orbit.
Instructions on using the fine maneuver editors.
The Orbit Information Panel is accessed by clicking on the maneuver mode button. This panel shows details about your current orbit, depending on which tab is selected.
Displays Inclination and Ejection Angle, Longitude of Ascending Node, Argument of Periapsis and Eccentricity.
Shows intercept information if a target is selected.
Displays Apoapsis, Periapsis and Orbital Period.
The left tab lets you see a visual representation of the maneuver you’re planning, along with some useful details about the time and dV used to perform that maneuver.
The top tab shows upcoming transfer windows to the available targets for your selected maneuver type.
Two tabs appear at the top and left of the maneuver tool panel that can give you some useful info.
The next section is where you configure the transfer. Pick the celestial body you want to go to which PE you want to target, and if you want a circularization dV readout.
The last section shows you details of the maneuver you would create with your current selections, and lets you create it if you’re satisfied.\r
